conditions.script:
current_user_name = frappe.session.user

conditions = f"""
    `tabTask`.project IN (
        SELECT parent
        FROM `tabProject Team Details`
        WHERE pt_participant = '{current_user_name}'
    )
"""

current_user_name = frappe.session.user

conditions = f"""
    `tabTask`.name IN (
        SELECT td.reference_name
        FROM `tabToDo` td
        WHERE td.reference_type = 'Issue'
        AND td.status = 'Open'
        AND td.allocated_to IN (
            SELECT ugm.user
            FROM `tabUser Group Member` ugm
            JOIN `tabUser Group` ug ON ug.name = ugm.parent
            WHERE ug.name IN (
                SELECT tl.parent
                FROM `tabTeamleads Table` tl
                WHERE tl.teamlead = '{current_user_name}'
                  AND tl.date <= CURDATE()
                  AND NOT EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM `tabTeamleads Table` tl_newer
                      WHERE tl_newer.parent = tl.parent
                        AND tl_newer.date > tl.date
                        AND tl_newer.date <= CURDATE()
                  )
            )
        )
    )
"""
